rules.statement: The District Court does not have jurisdiction to grant a declaration as a supervisory remedy to challenge the validity of judicial or quasi-judicial acts by statutory authorities.
rules.supporting_quote: "The District Courts in this country are creatures of statute and their jurisdiction and powers are defined and confined by the various statutes which give them jurisdiction but principally by the former Courts Ordinance (Cap. 6) and now the Administration of Justice Law No. 44 of 1973."
